name: Hating Someone
overview: Scripture teaches that while God hates certain things, including sin and evil as shown in Proverbs 6:16, believers are called to respond to those who hate them with love and forgiveness, following Christ’s example in Luke 6:27 and Mark 11:25. The command to love both God and neighbor (Luke 10:27) undergirds this attitude, emphasizing mercy over vengeance, as Romans 12:19 instructs believers to leave judgment to the Lord. Even in moments of anger, Ephesians 4:26 cautions against sinning, urging believers to resolve their wrath quickly and righteously.
